V2.1_happy_path_empirical_dT.method: Seed order PREPARING (status=7) via tinker → arm DOM-poll watcher every 100ms on [data-testid=pos-shortcut-ready-425] → bump to PREPARED (status=8) + event(OrderStatusChanged) → measure ms from bump_wall to first DOM appearance
V2.1_happy_path_empirical_dT.root_cause_analysis: POS panel NEVER receives Echo OrderStatusChanged broadcast — manual subscription to private-branch.1 from Playwright context also received 0 events post-bump despite queue worker draining the DispatchDomainEventsJob and Soketi being HTTP-reachable. Panel relies SOLELY on polling fallback (60 s cadence when _kioskPollingInterval() reports Echo connected). Run 1 caught the bump mid-poll-cycle (~17 s into a 60 s window); Run 2 caught it 32 s into the next window. Average ~24 s. Manual probe `_eventSub` on PosComponent at runtime returned undefined (Vue 3 internals partially scoped), but DOM-level evidence + zero echo events received on private-branch.1 + post-mount console warning `WebSocket connection to ws://127.0.0.1:6001/app/app-key failed: WebSocket is closed before the connection is established` + CSP report-only warning `Connecting to 'http://localhost:8000/api/broadcasting/auth' violates connect-src directive` confirms the Echo path is non-functional from /admin/pos despite pusher.connection.state==='connected'.

findings.title: KDS→POS sync ΔT degraded — 16.7-32.0 s vs Wave Polish 4.9 s target (3-7x regression)
findings.evidence_file_line: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosComponent.vue:2602-2604 _kioskPollingInterval() returns 60000 ms when window._wsService?.isConnected() is true. POS-side Echo subscription not effective: window.Echo.connector.channels === [] at /admin/pos runtime observation, indicating PosComponent._subscribeEcho() either failed silently or _eventSub never bound. Manual subscription to private-branch.1 from Playwright context also received 0 events post-bump despite queue worker draining and Soketi reachable.
findings.persona_impact_detail: Cashier-multitask: an order bumped to PREPARED on KDS takes up to 60 s to appear in the POS Prêt-à-livrer shortcut (worst case = poll-cycle align). Customer at counter receives no early signal that their order just became ready; cashier instead refreshes manually or relies on the kitchen runner shout. Erodes the 'always-render + ticker' Q10 promise: the panel is always-rendered but the data inside it lags. Client-impatient: same delay reflects on the counter wait time.
findings.adversarial_dispute_outcome: kept-and-escalated — Wave Polish Final B-002 caveated multi-tab Echo race but single-tab S2 reported 4.9 s as proof. This C2 audit is single-tab POS (no KDS or OSS open simultaneously) and still measures 16.7-32.0 s. The published 4.9 s figure does not hold on a fresh dev-server + freshly-logged-in admin session. Either Wave Polish B was measured under a different Echo configuration or a transient warm-cache effect that does not replicate here.
findings.fix_recommendation: Three layered fixes, ranked by impact: (1) Make _kioskPollingInterval() return 5000 ms unconditionally when readyOrders.length === 0 OR last successful loadReadyOrders > 30 s ago — so a 'dead Echo' state doesn't penalize the cashier. (2) Investigate why _subscribeEcho()/_eventSub does not show subscribed channel — likely the initial ws-connect failure at vendor.js:1661 puts WsService into an early-failure state but _wsService.isConnected() still returns true after auto-reconnect, leading POS to skip Echo binding while polling at 60 s. (3) Audit the CSP report 'localhost vs 127.0.0.1' broadcasting-auth host mismatch (pos-wizard.js source line says 'localhost'); if the channel auth POST is going to a different origin from the parent page, Sanctum/CSRF token may not attach and channel auth silently 401s.
findings.defer_decision: OPEN — V1 ship-blocker if owner reads Wave Polish convergence and expects 4.9 s. Either re-measure Wave Polish proof under same conditions or revise the 4.9 s number in CONVERGENCE_FINAL.md §5 Proof 2 to honest ~24 s polling-fallback figure (which is still acceptable for fast-food per CLAUDE.md but should not be advertised as 'real-time Echo').

findings.title: Silent Echo subscription failure on POS — no console error, no toast, no health signal
findings.evidence_file_line: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosComponent.vue:2625-2684 _subscribeEcho() — try/catch swallows the error and the comment line 2682 'Echo auth failed or Soketi not running — polling fallback handles it' explicitly accepts silent degradation. resources/js/services/eventContract.js:330-336 onEvents() returns a no-op stub if !window.Echo || branchId<=0 without logging.

console_warnings_present_but_subtle: WebSocket connection to ws://127.0.0.1:6001/app/app-key failed (transient on initial connect)
evidence_runtime_burst._eventSub_state: could not introspect via Playwright (Vue 3 internals) — proxy chain inaccessible

findings.persona_impact_detail: Operator running V1 has no visible indicator that Echo subscription failed. The 'Mis à jour il y a Xs' ticker still increments (5 s ticker runs independently of Echo), giving the cashier false confidence that real-time sync is alive. Q10 was specifically intended to make the calm-period-vs-broken-WebSocket distinction visible — this distinction is broken if Echo is silently degraded.
findings.adversarial_dispute_outcome: kept — designed-for-degradation pattern (polling fallback) without an observable signal IS the bug. Q10 last-refresh ticker is data-source-agnostic; it ticks even when Echo died — masking the failure.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add a health-state computed flag to PosComponent: `echoChannelHealthy = !!this._eventSub && window.Echo?.connector?.channels?.[`private-branch.${this.authBranchId()}`]`. Show a discrete badge `WS` (green when healthy, amber when polling-only) near the refresh ticker. Telemetry: emit one client-metric `pos_echo_health` per minute with the flag, so production analytics can detect site-wide Echo regressions before owner notices.
findings.defer_decision: V1.0.2 — non-blocking but masks an operational degradation. Should ship before SaaS multi-restaurant rollout.

summary.verdict_rationale: V2.2 (ticker), V2.3 (empty-state honest), V2.5 (Livré click clears row) are GREEN. V2.1 (happy path ΔT) and V2.4 (Echo+polling fallback target) FAIL — measured 16.7-32.0 s vs 4.9 s Wave Polish reference / 5 s target. Root cause: POS Echo subscription does not bind to private-branch.{id} in current dev-server state — relies on 60 s polling. The functionality WORKS (order does appear, Livré clears it, empty-state is honest) — only the LATENCY is off-spec. Acceptable for V1 fast-food per CLAUDE.md (sub-minute is humane) but the Wave Polish CONVERGENCE_FINAL.md 4.9 s proof should be re-measured or revised.
